raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out to Cedar Systems. We understand that your equipment maintenance team is facing challenges with spreadsheet coordination and are interested in workflow coordination and account reporting.

We would be happy to schedule a discovery meeting to better understand your specific requirements and how we can assist you. Please let us know a convenient time for you, and we will make the necessary arrangements.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
